review_notes: Read the whole file and checked Mathlib's Submodule.map_pow in Algebra/Algebra/Operations.lean. I found no existing lemma that gives the "alg hom maps P^n into Q^n from map P ≤ Q" step. The three degree-preservation proofs repeat that step. I did not look for other duplication: the gradedAlgebra instance and the congr proofs are not clearly repeated machinery. I cannot compile, so the proposed lemma is untested. The saving is modest, since the repeated block is about 5 lines in each proof.

findings.problem: Three proofs repeat the same step for passing from degree one to degree n. Each shows that an algebra hom sends the generating submodule P into Q (`Submodule.map f P ≤ Q`). Each then applies `pow_le_pow_left'` and rewrites with `Submodule.map_pow`, and each rebuilds the membership witness `⟨x, hx, rfl⟩` for the image of `P ^ n`. The `rw [Submodule.map_pow] at hx'` / `exact hx'` bookkeeping, with its `.toAlgHom.toLinearMap` coercion juggling, is also duplicated. Only the degree-one inclusion h₁ differs between the proofs, and that inclusion is the real mathematical content.
findings.proposed_change: Add a private lemma before `map_mem_homogeneousSubmodule`. Its statement is `lemma mem_pow_of_map_le {A B : Type*} [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) {P : Submodule R A} {Q : Submodule R B} (h : Submodule.map f.toLinearMap P ≤ Q) {n : ℕ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ P ^ n) : f x ∈ Q ^ n`. Proof sketch: `have := pow_le_pow_left' h n; rw [← Submodule.map_pow] at this; exact this ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩`. This is the body of lines 128–130. The three theorems then become: (1) `map_mem_homogeneousSubmodule f hx := mem_pow_of_map_le (map f) h₁ hx`, where h₁ is the existing `rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨f m, (map_ι_apply f m).symm⟩`. (2) `equivMvPolynomial_mem_homogeneousSubmodule`: keep the span induction for h₁ into `homogeneousSubmodule I R 1`, then `rw [← MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_pow]; exact mem_pow_of_map_le (equivMvPolynomial b).toAlgHom h₁ hx`. (3) `equivMvPolynomial_symm_mem_homogeneousSubmodule`: keep h₁ for the symm map, and use `rw [← MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_pow] at hp; exact mem_pow_of_map_le (equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toAlgHom h₁ hp`. The imports are unchanged, because `Submodule.map_pow` already comes in through the existing imports.
findings.benefit: Each proof then reduces to its degree-one inclusion. The `pow_le_pow_left'` / `map_pow` plumbing is written once, so a future change to how `Submodule.map_pow` is stated needs one fix instead of three. It also removes the two ad hoc `hx'`/`hp'` blocks that coerce `.toAlgHom.toLinearMap`.
